headline: US Dollar Jumps 88 Pesos to Reach 3,415 in Colombia, Largest Single-Day Rise
summary: The US dollar rose by 88 Colombian pesos in a single day to trade at 3,415 pesos, marking its steepest one-day gain since April 2025 and accumulating an increase of 193.91 pesos since November 5.
why: Rapid depreciation of the peso impacts domestic inflation and import pricing in Colombia, influencing future rate cuts by the central bank.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: The Colombian peso fell sharply as the dollar surged 88 pesos in a day to reach 3,415.
